blocks.text:
The verse adds the tune in the right hand over the intro's left hand.

**By the end** you can play bars 5–8 of *Hurt* with both hands.

# The tune
The right hand uses five notes: A, C, D, E and G. On the treble staff A is in the second space, C in the third, D on the fourth line, E in the top space, and **G** sits just above the top line. The tune starts on beat 4 of bar 5 with E, and moves mostly by step and skip within those notes.

Its rhythm has eighths, quarters and half notes, and some notes start between beats. Play its rhythm first, on any key.

blocks.title: The verse's rhythm
blocks.about: Rhythm mode: any key counts; only the timing is judged. Right hand, bars 5–8.
blocks.doneWhen: 80% of the notes on time in one run

blocks.title: The tune, right hand
blocks.about: Wait for me, right hand: the app plays the left hand.

blocks.text:
# Together
The left hand plays the same two bars as the intro, twice. Let it run on its own while you read the right hand. Wait for me waits for both hands at each step.

blocks.title: The verse in time
blocks.doneWhen: 80% of the notes on time in one run

blocks.text:
# If this happens
- **The hands wait for each other.** Play bar 5 alone, hands together, until it flows, then add bar 6.
- **Your eyes jump between staves.** Read the right hand; the left hand repeats, so trust it.

**Until the next lesson:** the verse once a day.
